system_overview: This specification is the model-checking configuration module for the HDiskSynod (hierarchical Disk Paxos invariant) specification. It provides concrete finite instantiations of the constants required for TLC model checking: process count, input values, disk set, ballot assignments, and the majority predicate. This enables TLC to verify the hierarchical invariants of the Disk Paxos algorithm on a small finite instance.
actors_and_components: Same as HDiskSynod: N processes communicating through shared disks, with auxiliary variables tracking the chosen value and accumulated inputs. This module adds concrete implementations for the ballot assignment function and the majority predicate.
state_variables: Same as HDiskSynod: input, output, disk blocks, phase, local disk block, disks written, blocks read, chosen value, and all-inputs set.
initial_state: Same as HDiskSynod, instantiated with the concrete constants.
actions: Same as HDiskSynod. No new actions are defined.
safety_properties: The module checks HInv1, HInv2, HInv3, HInv4, and HInv6 as invariants (HInv5 is omitted from the configuration). These verify type correctness, block consistency, read consistency, ballot dominance, and chosen-value safety.
model_bounds: N = 3 processes. Two input values. A special no-input constant. Each process gets a configurable number of ballot values (set via a ballot count constant), with ballots assigned as contiguous integer ranges offset by process identifier. Two disks. The majority predicate is implemented as strict majority: a set of disks is a majority if its size times two exceeds the total number of disks (i.e., at least 2 out of 2 disks for N=3 with 2 disks).
additional_assumptions: This module extends HDiskSynod and the TLC module. The ballot implementation assigns each process a contiguous range of ballot numbers starting at process-id times the ballot count per process. The majority implementation uses simple cardinality comparison. The initial and next-state relations use the hierarchical (H-prefixed) versions.
